breakdown.description: The chemical system is restricted to Ga-N, but the referenced stable-entry set is Mg-Ga-N.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still restricts the chemical system to Ga-N by filtering stable entries to only those containing Ga and N elements, then building a separate Ga-N phase diagram. The ground truth requires building the phase diagram from all stable entries in the Mg-Ga-N set without restricting to Ga-N. The agent repeated the original error of limiting the chemical system to Ga-N rather than using the full Mg-Ga-N stable entries.
